convertCurrency.note: FC5 conversion at an explicit connecting quote, orientation disclosed; round trip is the identity

coveredInterestParityForward.note: FC5 no-arbitrage forward: domestic = quote-currency rate, foreign = base-currency rate, compounding echoed

crossRate.note: FC5 cross rate through the ONE shared currency, every leg's orientation disclosed in the derivation

currencyExposure.note: FC5 per-currency exposure in a declared base; missing-pair positions excluded WITH reason, never guessed

foreignExchangeForwardPoints.note: FC5 (forward − spot) / pointSize with pointSize always explicit

foreignExchangeForwardValue.note: FC5 mark-to-market of an outstanding forward against an explicit quote-currency discount factor (matched-conventions law)

foreignExchangeSwapValue.note: FC5 swap = near leg + far leg, each valued by foreignExchangeForwardValue (composed, not copied)

HEDGED_PROFIT_AND_LOSS_DECOMPOSITION.note: FC5: the exact decomposition prose, frozen so tests and docs can quote it

hedgeRatio.note: FC5 hedge notional / exposure; zero exposure yields null-with-reason, never Infinity

invertCurrencyPairQuote.note: FC5 quote inversion: base/quote swapped, price reciprocated; involutive at 1e-12

nonDeliverableForwardValue.note: FC5 cash-settled NDF at a caller-supplied fixing; v1 settles in the pair's quote currency only

pipValue.note: FC5 pip value in quote and base currency; pipSize always explicit, never guessed from symbol spelling

requireCurrencyCode.note: FC5 boundary guard: uppercase three-letter ISO-style code, lowercase answered with the exact fix

requireCurrencyPairQuote.note: FC5 boundary guard: the closed CurrencyPairQuote contract (distinct codes, quotePerBase > 0); validates its own functionName/label first

spotForwardHedgedProfitAndLoss.note: FC5 hedged P&L with the exact unhedged/hedged decomposition frozen as a quotable constant
